form.label: Finding workbench
form.description: Triage agent enrichment, weighted evidence, recommended searches, and the follow-up score for one finding. F-1001–F-1012 are bundled demo ids (not Mission Control). Paste a real ES finding id only when using the ES API source.

search.query: | loadfindings mode=$mode$ finding_id=$finding_id$ limit=1 | eval mitre=mitre_techniques | table finding_id, title, urgency, status, owner, risk_score, user, src, dest, file_hash, domain, threat_object, mitre
| loadfindings mode=$mode$ finding_id=$finding_id$ limit=1 | table followup_score
| loadfindings mode=$mode$ finding_id=$finding_id$ limit=1 | table investigation_required
| loadfindings mode=$mode$ finding_id=$finding_id$ limit=1 | table followup_score_ceiling

| listenrichment finding_id=$finding_id$ | table finding_id, enrichment_posted, fea_followup_score, fea_investigation_required, fea_investigation_label, fea_evidence_net_weight, fea_executed_search_count, fea_override_applied, fea_triage_disposition, fea_agent_summary, enrichment_error
| loadfindings mode=$mode$ finding_id=$finding_id$ limit=1 | table triage_present, triage_disposition, triage_confidence, triage_summary, triage_justification, triage_tools
| loadfindings mode=$mode$ finding_id=$finding_id$ limit=1 | table rationale

| loadfindings mode=$mode$ finding_id=$finding_id$ limit=1 | spath input=score_breakdown_json | eval urgency=urgency.score, risk=risk.score, evidence=evidence.score, triage=triage.score, killchain=killchain.score, corroboration=corroboration.score | table urgency, risk, evidence, triage, killchain, corroboration | untable component score value | rename value as score

| loadfindings mode=$mode$ finding_id=$finding_id$ expand=evidence limit=1 | sort - evidence_signed_weight | table evidence_signed_weight, evidence_direction, evidence_source, evidence_class, evidence_title, evidence_detail, evidence_confidence

panel.title: Recommended evidence searches — click a row to run it in Search

search.query: | loadfindings mode=$mode$ finding_id=$finding_id$ expand=searches limit=1 | sort search_priority | table search_priority, potential_weight, search_category, search_name, search_purpose, search_spl
